description: This PHP file defines a controller class "ReportingMethodController" within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin. The class manages reporting method configurations, initializes a reporting service if not already instantiated, and sets up a Vue.js component for rendering reporting methods in the UI during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: ReportingMethodController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It handles dependency instantiation and prepares Vue.js components for rendering reporting method data.

methods.name: getReportingMethodService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService used to fetch reporting method data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with reporting method data to be rendered in the UI by adding the list of IDs currently in use.
